title: fix(preview): the Unpublished banner reads `_unpublished`, not `hidden`
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6955

The objectui half of the objectstack#4829 ruling A1. Framework half: objectstack-ai/objectstack#6942 (merged).

## What changed

Upstream split one flag into two with disjoint meanings: `_unpublished` is the machine-managed ADR-0045 publish gate (materialization sets it, publish clears it), while `hidden` became author-declared navigation presentation and nothing else — "Hidden apps stay fully routable and permission-checked".

`UnpublishedAppBar` read `hidden`, which after that split was wrong in **both** directions at once:

- **False positive** — a published, nav-hidden app (the built-in `account` app) wore the amber "only builders can see it" watermark while being live to every user.
- **False negative** — a genuinely unpublished app with no `hidden` set showed no bar. Since the server withholds unpublished apps from non-builders, that bar is the *builder's own* only signal that what they see is not live yet.

Not latent: console pin bump objectstack#7308 put an objectui build keying on `hidden` in front of a framework that had already redefined it, so both directions were live in the bundled console.

## Contract table — per-surface, before → after

| Surface | file:line (at `origin/main`) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unpublished banner read point | `packages/app-shell/src/preview/UnpublishedAppBar.tsx:47` | `app.hidden !== true` → bail | **`app._unpublished !== true` → bail** |
| Direct per-app publish body | `packages/app-shell/src/preview/UnpublishedAppBar.tsx:62` | `PUT /meta/app/{name}` `{ ...app, hidden: false }` | **`{ ...app, _unpublished: false }`** |
| Package publish button | `packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts:76`, `views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx:359`, `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:541`, `console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx:2133` | `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` | **unchanged** — the server-side flip already clears `_unpublished` |
| App Switcher | `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx:38` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ pinned against `_unpublished` |
| Launcher list | `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:177` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ comment-pinned |
| Home grid | `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx:267` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ comment-pinned |
| Root landing resolver | `apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.tsx:53` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ pinned by test |

`PUT /meta/app/{name}` has exactly one call site in the repo (the banner), so the direct-publish row is fully covered.

`_unpublished: false` rather than a key delete, matching the server's own publish-drafts flip: ADR-0045 §3 keeps publish/unpublish symmetric, so the gate stays two-state rather than a key whose absence has to be re-derived. Whatever `hidden` the app carries now rides through the write **untouched** — publishing must not silently rewrite the author's navigation choice, which is the regression objectstack#4829 was filed for.

## Why the launcher deliberately does NOT move

The symmetry ("the banner moved, so the launcher should too") is a trap, and the reason is layering rather than preference:

- `_unpublished` is enforced **server-side**. The REST metadata gate already withholds unpublished apps from everyone who should not see them, so an unpublished app that reaches the client belongs to a builder entitled to navigate to it. Filtering it here would hide a builder's in-progress app from the builder, buying no protection the server was not already providing.
- `hidden` is enforced **nowhere else**, by design. This client-side filter *is* its whole implementation; dropping it puts `account` back in the top-level switcher.

## Wire fields `unhiddenApps` / `unhideError` — decision: NOT renamed

**Measured, not assumed.** Two readings:

1. **Producer** — framework `origin/main`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:419` and `:426` still assign `unhideError` and `unhiddenApps` respectively. PR #6942 kept the spelling on purpose; the comment at `:337` states it is "a wire contract read by the objectui Publish button" and renaming it in a repo that cannot verify the consumer "would be a silent break of the exact kind #4829 is about".
2. **Consumer** — `git grep 'unhiddenApps\|unhideError'` across all of objectui `origin/main` returns **zero hits**. objectui does not read either field today.

So the card's "rename in lockstep, or not at all" resolves to **not at all**: the server still emits the old names, and there is no consumer read point to rename in lockstep with. A rename here would produce a client reading a field the server never sends. Whenever the rename is wanted, it needs a framework-side change first (or simultaneously), which is outside this card's repo.

## Tests

New `packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/UnpublishedAppBar.test.tsx` (the component had none): both directions of the split asserted separately, plus the publish **request body** — the defect class here is the right verb at the wrong key, which a status-code assertion cannot see. New `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppSwitcher.publishState.test.tsx` and one case added to `RootLandingRedirect.test.ts` pin the ⛔ non-change.

**Reverse verification, run in both directions** — the ⛔ half pins a deliberate non-change, so reverting the fix cannot exercise it:

1. Reverted `UnpublishedAppBar.tsx` to `origin/main` → **5 of 8 red**, exactly the predicted set: both banner-direction cases, the two-state case and both write-body cases. The 3 that stayed green are the ones true under either reading (unpublished-and-hidden, neither-flag, preview-mode yield) — reported rather than papered over.
2. Injected `&& a._unpublished !== true` into the AppSwitcher filter — the mistake the pin guards → **the ⛔ case went red** ("Unable to find an element with the text: Draft App"), the other 3 stayed green.

Both edits were taken out with `git checkout` / a file copy, never `git stash`.

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/   → Test Files 334 passed (334) | Tests 3123 passed | 1 skipped
pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/         → Test Files  33 passed  (33) | Tests  346 passed
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check  → clean (tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.typetests.json)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/console   type-check  → clean (tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint        → 0 errors (2264 pre-existing warnings, none from these files)
```

Typecheck runs against `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0-rc.6`, which is what makes `_unpublished` resolvable.

## Spec pickup — already on `main`, no lockfile change in this PR

The card's sequencing note expected this PR to carry the `@objectstack/spec` bump. It does not need to: `origin/main` **already** pins `^17.0.0-rc.6` in all 30 workspace manifests, and `pnpm-lock.yaml` already resolves `17.0.0-rc.6` for every one of them. `pnpm install` in a fresh worktree left the lockfile byte-identical. Verified in the installed types: `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/dist/app.zod-CH7IEmsS.d.ts:650` — `_unpublished: z.ZodOptional(z.ZodBoolean)`.

## Changeset

Added, per repo convention (`.changeset/` is present and every recent user-visible fix carries one). `@object-ui/app-shell` patch only — the `apps/console` change is test-only and `console` is not a published package.
